disclaimer: Aggregate indicators from an automated guardrail. Lexical and model-based checks have error rates; see the published limitations. Not a certification of compliance.

kpis.name: Confirmed Tier 3 violations
kpis.formula: confirmed_tier3 decisions / decisions x 10,000
kpis.plain_language: How often did the AI try to do something really hurtful? Lower is better.

kpis.name: Escaped harms
kpis.formula: approved decisions later confirmed harmful (escaped_harm events) / decisions x 10,000
kpis.plain_language: How often did something hurtful sneak past the guard? This should be almost never.

kpis.name: Near-miss rate (leading indicator)
kpis.formula: decisions with near_miss / decisions
kpis.plain_language: How often did the AI *almost* say something hurtful? Like the yellow warning light in Mario Kart before you fall off the track.

kpis.name: False-refusal rate
kpis.formula: upheld appeals / reviewed appeals, by topic and language
kpis.plain_language: When the guard said 'no' and a grown-up checked, how often was the guard wrong?

kpis.name: Time to human review
kpis.formula: median hours from appeal filed to reviewed
kpis.plain_language: When someone asks a grown-up to double-check a 'no', how long do they wait?

kpis.name: Protected-speech canary pass rate
kpis.formula: passed / total items in the latest protected_speech canary run
kpis.plain_language: Did the guard ever hide the 'test newspaper'? It never should.

kpis.name: Energy per 1,000 interactions
kpis.formula: sum(actual kWh, else estimated) / decisions x 1,000
kpis.plain_language: How much electricity did the AI eat for every 1,000 questions?

kpis.name: Carbon per interaction
kpis.formula: sum(kWh x grid carbon intensity) / decisions
kpis.plain_language: How much smoke went into the sky for each question?

kpis.name: Energy budget used
kpis.formula: budget_used / budget_limit at the latest decision (with linear exhaustion forecast)
kpis.plain_language: How much of the AI's energy allowance is used up -- like a phone battery?

kpis.name: Metered energy share
kpis.formula: decisions with a metered energy record / decisions
kpis.plain_language: Was the battery really measured, or did the AI just say 'trust me'?

kpis.name: Verified community consent
kpis.formula: community-affecting decisions with a consent_verified event / community-affecting decisions
kpis.plain_language: Before the AI did something that affects a village, did it have a real signed permission slip?

kpis.name: Published, canary-safe community rules
kpis.formula: community rules with legal basis + adopting body that pass the protected-speech canary / all rules
kpis.plain_language: Are the village rules posted where everyone can see them, and do none of them hide the news?

kpis.name: Consent revocations honoured in time
kpis.formula: revocations honoured within 72 hours / revocations
kpis.plain_language: When a village says 'stop', does the AI stop quickly?

kpis.name: Audit-chain integrity
kpis.formula: records whose MAC and link verify / records
kpis.plain_language: Is the diary complete, with no torn-out or rewritten pages?

kpis.name: Audit completeness
kpis.formula: records written / (records written + sink failures)
kpis.plain_language: Did every decision get written in the diary?

kpis.name: Incident reports on time
kpis.formula: confirmed Tier 3 decisions with an incident report within 15 days / confirmed Tier 3 decisions
kpis.plain_language: When something bad happened, did they tell the grown-ups within two weeks?

kpis.name: Circuit-breaker trips
kpis.formula: count of trips; share of trips over 1 hour that a human confirmed
kpis.plain_language: How many times was the emergency brake pulled -- and did a grown-up agree each long time?

kpis.name: Independent red-team evasion rate
kpis.formula: evasions / attempts in independent red-team runs
kpis.plain_language: How often do the practice bad guys sneak past the guard?

kpis.name: Channel coverage
kpis.formula: decisions with no unscreened content / decisions
kpis.plain_language: Are all the doors and windows being watched?

kpis.name: Fail-closed events
kpis.formula: decisions with an evaluator/judge infrastructure error / decisions x 10,000
kpis.plain_language: How often did the guard say 'I'm not sure, so no' because its radio broke?

kpis.name: Human override rate
kpis.formula: human_override events / decisions (healthy band: people still check and change)
kpis.plain_language: Do people still make the final choice? Too few changes can mean people stopped thinking; too many can mean the AI is not helpful.

kpis.name: Directive-language share
kpis.formula: approved decisions whose agency score < 1 (directive wording) / approved decisions
kpis.plain_language: Does the AI give choices, like a choose-your-own-adventure book, or boss people around?

kpis.name: Scaffold ratio (learning contexts)
kpis.formula: learning-context responses that scaffold or mix / learning-context responses
kpis.plain_language: Does the AI help you climb the wall, or carry you over it? A good coach gives tips so *you* get stronger, like training your own Pokemon team.

kpis.name: Over-protection index
kpis.formula: (legitimate_challenge canary failures + upheld appeals on challenge topics) / (canary items + challenge appeals)
kpis.plain_language: Does the guard wrap everything in bubble wrap? Some challenge is how you grow.

kpis.name: Refusal disparity across languages
kpis.formula: max / min refusal rate across languages with n >= k
kpis.plain_language: Is the guard equally fair to every kid, whatever language they speak?

kpis.name: Output diversity
kpis.formula: mean over task classes of distinct completions / completions (n >= k per class)
kpis.plain_language: Are answers staying different for different places, like each Minecraft village being its own village?

kpis.name: Value-return ratio (worst region)
kpis.formula: min over regions of returned value / extracted value
kpis.plain_language: Some villages gave lots of treasure (data and work) and got little back -- like trading a Charizard for a Magikarp. Is the trade being made fair?

kpis.name: Local capacity share (worst region)
kpis.formula: min over regions of compute/storage/serving located in-region
kpis.plain_language: Is the AI's 'kitchen' built in the village it serves, or far away?

kpis.name: Service-parity index
kpis.formula: min / max service-quality score across regions and languages
kpis.plain_language: Does every village get equally good help, or do some get the leftovers?

alerts.title: Escalating dehumanisation signals (extermination)
alerts.public_summary: Signals in one deployment escalated from 'extermination' to 'extermination' on Stanton's stages of genocide.
alerts.plain_language: The smoke detector beeped: people are being sorted and called names in a way that, in history, came before terrible harm.
alerts.recommended_action: Escalate to human-rights reviewers and the ICT now; check what the deployment is being used for and by whom.

alerts.title: Value is leaving East Africa without enough coming back
alerts.public_summary: East Africa: 15% of extracted value has been returned, below the 50% target.
alerts.plain_language: The village gave lots of treasure and got little back. The trade needs to be made fair.
alerts.recommended_action: Trigger the benefit-sharing obligation (Act Art. 4(5)) and report to the ICT; this agent does not move resources itself.

alerts.title: New policy is invalid and must not be deployed
alerts.public_summary: A proposed policy failed validation because a community rule would censor protected speech.
alerts.plain_language: The new rulebook breaks the rules for rulebooks -- one rule would hide the news.
alerts.recommended_action: Reject the change; return it to the issuing body with the errors.

alerts.title: An incident report is overdue
alerts.public_summary: A confirmed Tier 3 incident has not been reported to the ICT within 15 days.
alerts.plain_language: Something bad happened and the grown-ups haven't been told yet -- the homework is late!
alerts.recommended_action: File the Art. 12 report using the attached draft.

alerts.title: A single caller is heading for suspension
alerts.public_summary: One caller is repeatedly producing confirmed violations; a per-caller suspension is likely soon.
alerts.plain_language: One player keeps trying to make the AI say mean things. They'll get a time-out soon unless someone steps in.
alerts.recommended_action: Review the caller's recent requests; consider throttling or contacting them. The system stays open for everyone else.

alerts.title: Learners in cohort 'school-A' are getting answers instead of help
alerts.public_summary: The share of learning responses that scaffold is falling (85% -> 56%); on trend it drops below 40% around 2026-09-27.
alerts.plain_language: The AI is doing the homework instead of coaching -- the learners' muscles could get weak.
alerts.recommended_action: Switch this cohort to a hints-first (scaffolding) mode and review with educators (Act Art. 5(5)).

alerts.title: Traffic in 'sw' fell sharply after a policy change
alerts.public_summary: Use of the system in one language fell by 66% after the latest policy change.
alerts.plain_language: After the rules changed, people who speak one language mostly stopped coming. Were they pushed out?
alerts.recommended_action: Check whether the change blocks or degrades that language; consult the affected community.

alerts.title: Escalating dehumanisation signals (dehumanisation)
alerts.public_summary: Signals in one deployment escalated from 'dehumanisation' to 'dehumanisation' on Stanton's stages of genocide.
alerts.plain_language: The smoke detector beeped: people are being sorted and called names in a way that, in history, came before terrible harm.
alerts.recommended_action: Escalate to human-rights reviewers and the ICT now; check what the deployment is being used for and by whom.

alerts.title: Value is leaving South Asia without enough coming back
alerts.public_summary: South Asia: 82% of extracted value has been returned; on trend it falls below 50% around 2026-12-09.
alerts.plain_language: The village gave lots of treasure and got little back. The trade needs to be made fair.
alerts.recommended_action: Trigger the benefit-sharing obligation (Act Art. 4(5)) and report to the ICT; this agent does not move resources itself.

alerts.title: Energy estimates are consistently too low
alerts.public_summary: A deployer's declared energy is well below metered use (median x4.0).
alerts.plain_language: Someone keeps saying they used a little electricity, but the meter says they used a lot more.
alerts.recommended_action: Require metered energy for this deployer (K-10) and correct its budget accounting.

alerts.title: Near-misses are creeping up
alerts.public_summary: The near-miss rate has drifted from 0.7% to 10.4%; on trend it passes 15% around 2026-09-28.
alerts.plain_language: The AI is getting closer to saying hurtful things more often -- time to steady the tower.
alerts.recommended_action: Check recent model, prompt or policy changes; review flagged near-miss samples; consider enabling or tightening the judge.

alerts.title: Safeguard relaxed: governance.fail_closed
alerts.public_summary: A proposed policy relaxes governance.fail_closed (True -> False).
alerts.plain_language: Someone wants to loosen one of the guard's safety dials.
alerts.recommended_action: Require a stated reason and sign-off before deploying.

alerts.title: Community actions without verified consent
alerts.public_summary: 18% of community-affecting actions lack verified consent.
alerts.plain_language: The AI did things that affect a village without a real permission slip.
alerts.recommended_action: Pause community-affecting features until consent is verified (K-11).

alerts.title: Little local capacity in East Africa
alerts.public_summary: Only 10% of compute serving East Africa is located there.
alerts.plain_language: The AI's kitchen is far away from the village it cooks for.
alerts.recommended_action: Plan local capacity with the Epistemic Protection Fund (Annex A(2)).

models.plain_language: A great helper: it stops the mean stuff and still lets people think for themselves.
A good helper, with a couple of things to work on.
Just OK. Some important things need fixing.
